initialize_distributed_training: initialize a distributed training process group with NCCL backend and Megatron model parallel support
spawn_distributed_processes: spawn multiple GPU processes for distributed training using torch multiprocessing with automatic rank assignment
all_gather_list: gather arbitrary picklable Python data from all distributed workers into a single list
all_reduce_dict: all-reduce a dictionary of tensor and scalar values across distributed workers with separate CPU and GPU handling
broadcast_object: broadcast an arbitrary Python object containing tensors to all workers in a distributed process group
